claim.supported_scope: Comparison of one preregistered unstandardized structural path between exactly two observed groups using simultaneous ordinary-ML cbsem_ml_v1 fits, a one-constraint likelihood-ratio test, and within-group cbsem_bootstrap_v2 resampling.
claim.estimand: The unstandardized coefficient difference beta_group1 minus beta_group2, its one-degree-of-freedom equality-constraint likelihood-ratio test, and its percentile bootstrap interval.
assumptions: Exactly two mutually exclusive groups share the same reflective continuous configural model, observed variables, marker convention, preprocessing, and estimator.
Qualified cbsem_invariance_v2 metric invariance is established before the structural path comparison.

The workflow independently qualifies stratified reuse of cbsem_bootstrap_v2 case-resampling, seed, quantile, and failure rules while refitting both groups, and both constrained and unconstrained fits are converged and admissible.
exclusions: Three or more groups, latent classes, unequal measurement forms, automated path scanning, multiple-path multiplicity, latent means, ordinal/robust estimators, and clustered samples are excluded.
Standardized path differences are descriptive only and are not the inferential estimand.
The synthetic cbsem_multigroup_v1 preview cannot be promoted or relabeled as v2.
warnings: Group comparison validity depends on measurement invariance, group sample adequacy, and correct independent-group specification.
A nonzero coefficient difference is not evidence that group membership causes the difference.

references.citation: Joreskog (1971), Simultaneous Factor Analysis in Several Populations, DOI 10.1007/BF02291466
Meredith (1993), Measurement Invariance, Factor Analysis and Factorial Invariance, DOI 10.1007/BF02294825
Independent Python two-group constrained-ML and stratified-bootstrap reference

simulations.design: Two-group invariant SEMs under equal and unequal target paths across balanced/unbalanced group sizes, loading strength, path magnitude, and moderate nonnormality.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen group-specific data-generation and within-group bootstrap streams indexed by scenario and replicate.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Null rejection and interval coverage must meet preregistered Monte Carlo limits, power and bias must meet scenario limits, and invalid/invariance-failing cases must be blocked.

simulations.design: Small groups, missing group labels, failed metric invariance, inadmissible group fits, and bootstrap threshold failures.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen adversarial fixtures and replicate streams.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every unsupported or failed case must match the specified block/reason behavior and same-seed retry must reproduce uninterrupted output.

boundaries.case: A group is too small, singular, nonconverged, non-finite, or inadmissible for the frozen model.
boundaries.expected_behavior: MGA is unavailable and no path-difference inference is emitted.

boundaries.case: There are not exactly two groups, measurement forms differ, metric invariance failed, or multiple paths are requested.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Setup is blocked before structural comparison.

boundaries.case: Group 1 and group 2 labels are swapped while observations are unchanged.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Delta_beta and percentile interval endpoints reverse sign, while two-sided likelihood-ratio results remain equal.

boundaries.case: The same data, group map, target path, settings, and seed run with different worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Group fits, constraints, resamples, failures, and summaries are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: A group label/count, invariance prerequisite, path estimate, constraint, fit, replicate, interval, or method identity is changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose identity differs from CB-SEM two-group MGA v2.
Reject output relabeled from cbsem_multigroup_v1 or another method.
Reject either group or resample when the dataset fingerprint differs.
Reject an archive entry whose group model, invariance, bootstrap, or result checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid groups, inconsistent constraints, non-finite deltas, or impossible replicate counts.
Never reinterpret apportioned pooled-fit or synthetic equality diagnostics from cbsem_multigroup_v1 as v2 evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: The cbsem_multigroup_v1 preview remains experimental and is permanently ineligible for v2 evidence or migration.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must produce identical group rows, constrained fits, stratified resamples, failures, and path-difference results for the same recipe and seed.
accessibility_rules: Every group comparison visual has an equivalent accessible table.
Direction, uncertainty, invariance status, failures, and warnings are communicated without color alone.
